Banakisɛ in bɛ mɔgɔ minnu na a bɛ sɔrɔ olu banakɔtaa fɛ; saniya matarafabaliya bɛ a to banakisɛ in bɛ don ji minta la, walima dumuniw, o la mɔgɔ minnu bɛ o dumuniw dun, bana in bɛ se ka olu fana minɛ.Banakisɛbànakisɛnmicrobebànanmaladiekìsɛngrain inìndtmDEF bɛbɛ́copêtre mɔgɔmɔ̀gɔnhomme minnumínnudtmREL.PL2mîndtmRELlumrphPL2 nanáppà aàpers3SG bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF sɔrɔsɔ̀rɔvobtenir oluòlûpersce.PL2òprncelumrphPL2 banakɔtaabánakɔtaanexcrément.humainbánanextérieur.du.villagekɔ́ppaprèstáavaller fɛfɛ̀pppar ; saniyasániyanpropretésánivqpropreyamrphDEQU matarafabaliyamàtarafabaliyanmàtarafavfréquenterbalimrphPTCP.NEGyamrphABSTR bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF aàpers3SG totóvrester banakisɛbànakisɛnmicrobebànanmaladiekìsɛngrain inìndtmDEF bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF dondònventrer jijíneau mintamìntaptcppotablemìnvboiretamrphPTCP.POT laláppà , walimawàlímàconjou.bien dumuniwdúmuniwndúmuninaction.de.mangerdúnvmangerlimrphNMLZwmrphPL , oòprnce laláppà mɔgɔmɔ̀gɔnhomme minnumínnudtmREL.PL2mîndtmRELlumrphPL2 bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF oòdtmce dumuniwdúmuniwndúmuninaction.de.mangerdúnvmangerlimrphNMLZwmrphPL dundúnvmanger , banabànanmaladie inìndtmDEF bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF sesévarriver kakàpmINF oluòlûpersce.PL2òprncelumrphPL2 fanafánaprtaussi minɛmìnɛvattraper .

Bana taamasiɲɛw:Banabànanmaladie taamasiɲɛwtàamashiyɛnwntàamashyɛnnmarquewmrphPL :

<ill>Banakisɛ min yera mikɔrɔsikɔpu fɛ</ill>.<ill> Banakisɛbànakisɛnmicrobebànanmaladiekìsɛngrain minmîndtmREL yerayéravyévvoirramrphPFV.INTR mikɔrɔsikɔpumikɔrɔsikɔpunmicroscope fɛfɛ̀pppar </ill> . <ill>Mikɔrɔsikɔpu</ill>.<ill> Mikɔrɔsikɔpumikɔrɔsikɔpunmicroscope </ill> .

Bana in taamasiɲɛ tɛ ye mɔgɔ ye ɲɛna na.Banabànanmaladie inìndtmDEF taamasiɲɛtàamashyɛnnmarque tɛtɛpmIPFV.NEG yeyévvoir mɔgɔmɔ̀gɔnhomme yeyéppPP ɲɛnaɲɛ́nanvueɲɛ́noeilláppà nanáppà . O de la a banakisɛ bɛ se ka kɔnɔboli juguman walima tɔgɔtɔgɔnin (banakɔtaa ni joli) bila mɔgɔ la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, bana wɛrɛ bɛ mɔgɔ minnu na walima balodɛsɛ.Oòprnce dedèprtFOC laláppà aàpers3SG banakisɛbànakisɛnmicrobebànanmaladiekìsɛngrain bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF sesévarriver kakàpmINF kɔnɔbolikɔ́nɔbolindiarrhéekɔ́nɔnventrebòlincourse jugumanjúgumanadjméchantjúguvqméchantmanmrphADJ walimawàlímàconjou.bien tɔgɔtɔgɔnintɔ̀gɔtɔgɔninndysenterieninmrphDIM ( banakɔtaabánakɔtaanexcrément.humainbánanextérieur.du.villagekɔ́ppaprèstáavaller niniconjet jolijòlinsang ) bilabìlavmettre mɔgɔmɔ̀gɔnhomme laláppà , kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenyakɛ́rɛnkɛrɛnnenyanparticularismekɛ́rɛnkɛrɛnnenptcpspécialkɛ́rɛnkɛrɛnvêtre.à.partlenmrphPTCP.RESyamrphABSTR laláppà , banabànanmaladie wɛrɛwɛ́rɛdtmautre bɛbɛ́copêtre mɔgɔmɔ̀gɔnhomme minnumínnudtmREL.PL2mîndtmRELlumrphPL2 nanáppà walimawàlímàconjou.bien balodɛsɛbálodɛsɛnpénuriebálovvivredɛ́sɛvéchouer .

Tɔgɔtɔgɔnin taamasiɲɛ ye:Tɔgɔtɔgɔnintɔ̀gɔtɔgɔninndysenterieninmrphDIM taamasiɲɛtàamashyɛnnmarque yeyécopEQU :

Kɔnɔboli bɛ taa ka segin, tuma dɔ la kɔnɔ bɛ ja.Kɔnɔbolikɔ́nɔbolindiarrhéekɔ́nɔnventrebòlincourse bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF taatáavaller kakàpmINF seginsèginvrevenir , tumatùmanmoment dɔdɔ́dtmcertain laláppà kɔnɔkɔ́nɔnventre bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF jajàvsécher . Kɔnɔnugutigɛ bɛ kɛ a la, ɲɛgɛnnataa nege bɛ a tigi minɛ tuma bɛɛ, nka ni a taara, a tɛ banakɔtaa fosi sɔrɔ, a dɔw la yiriyiri dɔrɔn de bɛ bɔ.Kɔnɔnugutigɛkɔ́nɔnugutigɛncrampe.d'estomackɔ́nɔnugunintestinkɔ́nɔnventrenùgunintestintìgɛvcouper bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF kɛkɛ́vfaire aàpers3SG laláppà , ɲɛgɛnnataaɲɛ́gɛnnataanɲɛ́gɛnndouchièrenáppàtáandépart negenègendésir bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF aàpers3SG tigitìginmaître minɛmìnɛvattraper tumatùmanmoment bɛɛbɛ́ɛdtmtout , nkaǹkaconjmais niníconjsi aàpers3SG taaratáaravtáavallerramrphPFV.INTR , aàpers3SG tɛtɛpmIPFV.NEG banakɔtaabánakɔtaanexcrément.humainbánanextérieur.du.villagekɔ́ppaprèstáavaller fosifósìprnrien sɔrɔsɔ̀rɔvobtenir , aàpers3SG dɔwdɔ́wprndɔ́prncertainwmrphPL laláppà yiriyiriyìriyirinmucus dɔrɔndɔ́rɔndtmseulement dedèprtFOC bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF bɔbɔ́vsortir . Nɔgɔ ni yiriyiri caman bɛ bɔ (a ka ca a la a jilama tɛ), tuma dɔw la a ni joli bɛ bɔ.Nɔgɔnɔ́gɔnsaleté niniconjet yiriyiriyìriyirinmucus camancámanadjnombreuxcávqnombreuxmanmrphADJ bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF bɔbɔ́vsortir ( aàpers3SG kakapmQUAL.AFF cacávqnombreux aàpers3SG laláppà aàpers3SG jilamajílamaadjliquidejíneaulamamrphSTAT tɛtɛ́copCOP.NEG ), tumatùmanmoment dɔwdɔ́wprndɔ́prncertainwmrphPL laláppà aàpers3SG niniconjet jolijòlinsang bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF bɔbɔ́vsortir . Ni bana ka jugu kosɛbɛ, ni basi caman bɛ bɔ, olu bɛ mɔgɔ fanga dɔgɔya ka u bana.Niníconjsi banabànanmaladie kakapmQUAL.AFF jugujúguvqméchant kosɛbɛkósɛbɛadvtrès.bienkónaffairesɛ̀bɛadjsérieux , niníconjsi basibásinsang camancámanadjnombreuxcávqnombreuxmanmrphADJ bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF bɔbɔ́vsortir , oluòlûpersce.PL2òprncelumrphPL2 bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF mɔgɔmɔ̀gɔnhomme fangafànganforce dɔgɔyadɔ́gɔyavamoindrirdɔ́gɔvqétroityamrphDEQU kakàpmINF uùpers3PL banabànavtomber.malade . Ni farigan bɛ a senkɔrɔ o bɛ se ka a jira ko banakisɛ fana sen bɛ a la.Niníconjsi fariganfàrigannfièvrefàrincorpsgànnfièvre bɛbɛ́copêtre aàpers3SG senkɔrɔsènkɔ́rɔppparmisènnjambekɔ́rɔppsous oòprnce bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF sesévarriver kakàpmINF aàpers3SG jirajìravmontrer kokócopQUOT banakisɛbànakisɛnmicrobebànanmaladiekìsɛngrain fanafánaprtaussi sensènnjambe bɛbɛ́copêtre aàpers3SG laláppà .

Basi bɔ bɛ kɔnɔboli min senkɔrɔ, o sababu bɛ se ka kɛ tɔgɔtɔgɔnin banakisɛ ye walima banakisɛ wɛrɛ, o la farigan bɛ to sen na waati bɛɛ.Basibásinsang bɔbɔ́nsortie bɛbɛ́copêtre kɔnɔbolikɔ́nɔbolindiarrhéekɔ́nɔnventrebòlincourse minmîndtmREL senkɔrɔsènkɔ́rɔppparmisènnjambekɔ́rɔppsous , oòprnce sababusábabuncause bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF sesévarriver kakàpmINF kɛkɛ́vfaire tɔgɔtɔgɔnintɔ̀gɔtɔgɔninndysenterieninmrphDIM banakisɛbànakisɛnmicrobebànanmaladiekìsɛngrain yeyéppPP walimawàlímàconjou.bien banakisɛbànakisɛnmicrobebànanmaladiekìsɛngrain wɛrɛwɛ́rɛdtmautre , oòprnce laláppà fariganfàrigannfièvrefàrincorpsgànnfièvre bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF totóvrester sensènnjambe nanáppà waatiwáatinmoment bɛɛbɛ́ɛdtmtout . O de la tɔgɔtɔtɔni banakisɛ in <c>(Shigellose)</c> bɛ cun mɔgɔ kan, banakɔtaa bɛ magaya (a bɛ kɛ jilama ye), o bɛɛ la farigan bɛ to sen na (aw bɛ gafe ɲɛ Furakɛli kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ka a ɲɛsin kɔnɔboli suguyaw ma lajɛ) i n'a fɔ a kɛcogo kɔrɔ:Oòprnce dedèprtFOC laláppà tɔgɔtɔtɔnitɔ̀gɔtɔgɔninndysenterieninmrphDIM banakisɛbànakisɛnmicrobebànanmaladiekìsɛngrain inìndtmDEF <c>(Shigellose)</c> bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF cuncúnvse.laisser.tomber mɔgɔmɔ̀gɔnhomme kankànppsur , banakɔtaabánakɔtaanexcrément.humainbánanextérieur.du.villagekɔ́ppaprèstáavaller bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF magayamàgayavrendre.moumàganvqmouyamrphDEQU ( aàpers3SG bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF kɛkɛ́vfaire jilamajílamaadjliquidejíneaulamamrphSTAT yeyéppPP ), oòprnce bɛɛbɛ́ɛdtmtout laláppà fariganfàrigannfièvrefàrincorpsgànnfièvre bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF totóvrester sensènnjambe nanáppà ( awáwpers2PL.EMPH bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF gafegáfenlivre ɲɛɲɛ́noeil Furakɛlifúrakɛlintraitementfúrakɛvsoignerfúranfeuillekɛ́vfairelimrphNMLZ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenkɛ́rɛnkɛrɛnnenptcpkɛ́rɛnkɛrɛnvêtre.à.partlenmrphPTCP.RES kakàpmINF aàpers3SG ɲɛsinɲɛ́sinvs'orienterɲɛ́noeilsínvdiriger kɔnɔbolikɔ́nɔbolindiarrhéekɔ́nɔnventrebòlincourse suguyawsúguyawnsúguyanespècesúgunespèceyamrphABSTRwmrphPL mamàppADR lajɛlájɛvregarderlámrphCAUSjɛ́vblanchir ) iípers2SG n'n'pmCERT aàpers3SG fɔfɔ́vdire aàpers3SG kɛcogokɛ́cogonmanière.de.fairekɛ́vfairecógonmanière kɔrɔkɔ̀rɔadjvieux :

Kɔnɔboli + basi + farigan = bana min sababu ye banakisɛ ye (tɔgɔtɔgɔnin banakisɛ suguya wɛrɛ<c>, Shigellose</c>).Kɔnɔbolikɔ́nɔbolindiarrhéekɔ́nɔnventrebòlincourse + basibásinsang + fariganfàrigannfièvrefàrincorpsgànnfièvre = banabànanmaladie minmîndtmREL sababusábabuncause yeyécopEQU banakisɛbànakisɛnmicrobebànanmaladiekìsɛngrain yeyéppPP ( tɔgɔtɔgɔnintɔ̀gɔtɔgɔninndysenterieninmrphDIM banakisɛbànakisɛnmicrobebànanmaladiekìsɛngrain suguyasúguyanespècesúgunespèceyamrphABSTR wɛrɛwɛ́rɛdtmautre <c>, Shigellose</c> ) . Kɔnɔboli + basi + farigan tɛ = tɔgɔtɔgɔnin <c>(dysenterie amibienne)</c>.Kɔnɔbolikɔ́nɔbolindiarrhéekɔ́nɔnventrebòlincourse + basibásinsang + fariganfàrigannfièvrefàrincorpsgànnfièvre tɛtɛ́copCOP.NEG = tɔgɔtɔgɔnintɔ̀gɔtɔgɔninndysenterieninmrphDIM <c>(dysenterie amibienne)</c> .

O bɛ dimi kɛ kɔnɔbara kiniboloyanfan sanfɛla la, a bɛ yɛlɛn disi la, wa dimi bɛ juguya ni a tigi bɛ taama.Oòprnce bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF dimidíminsouffrance kɛkɛ́vfaire kɔnɔbarakɔ́nɔbaranventrekɔ́nɔnventrebàrancalebasse kiniboloyanfankiniboloyanfannkíninbolonmain.droitekíninndroitebólonbrasyànfannce.côté-ciyànncet.endroitfànncôté sanfɛlasánfɛlanle.hautsánfɛ̀pppar-dessussánncielfɛ̀ppparlamrphLOC laláppà , aàpers3SG bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF yɛlɛnyɛ̀lɛnvmonter disidísinpoitrine laláppà , wawàconjalors dimidíminsouffrance bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF juguyajúguyavêtre.méchantjúguvqméchantyamrphDEQU niníconjsi aàpers3SG tigitìginmaître bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF taamatáamavmarcher . (a ni kunankunandimi bɛɛ ye suguya kelen ye, aw ye sɛbɛn ɲɛ Kunankunandimi lajɛ; sayi, aw ye sɛbɛn ɲɛ Biɲɛdimi lajɛ; ani biɲɛdimi la, aw ye sɛbɛn ɲɛ Biɲɛdimi lajɛ).( aàpers3SG niniconjet kunankunandimikúnankunandiminnkúnankùnannbiledíminsouffrance bɛɛbɛ́ɛdtmtout yeyécopEQU suguyasúguyanespècesúgunespèceyamrphABSTR kelenkélennumun yeyéppPP , awáwpers2PL.EMPH yeyépmIMP sɛbɛnsɛ́bɛnnécrit ɲɛɲɛ́noeil Kunankunandimikúnankunandiminnkúnankùnannbiledíminsouffrance lajɛlájɛvregarderlámrphCAUSjɛ́vblanchir ; sayisáyinjaunisse , awáwpers2PL.EMPH yeyépmIMP sɛbɛnsɛ́bɛnnécrit ɲɛɲɛ́noeil Biɲɛdimibíɲɛdiminhépatitebíɲɛnfoiedíminsouffrance lajɛlájɛvregarderlámrphCAUSjɛ́vblanchir ; aniàníprepainsi.que biɲɛdimibíɲɛdiminhépatitebíɲɛnfoiedíminsouffrance laláppà , awáwpers2PL.EMPH yeyépmIMP sɛbɛnsɛ́bɛnnécrit ɲɛɲɛ́noeil Biɲɛdimibíɲɛdiminhépatitebíɲɛnfoiedíminsouffrance lajɛlájɛvregarderlámrphCAUSjɛ́vblanchir ) . Ni nin taamasiɲɛ ninnu bɛ mɔgɔ min na ni o tora ka sɔgɔsɔgɔ ka ji ɲɛlafinman dɔ bɔ, o bɛ a jira ko bana in bɛ a fogonfogon la.Niníconjsi ninnìndtmDEM taamasiɲɛtàamashyɛnnmarque ninnunìnnúdtmDEM.PLnìndtmDEMlumrphPL2 bɛbɛ́copêtre mɔgɔmɔ̀gɔnhomme minmîndtmREL nanáppà niníconjsi oòprnce toratóravtóvresterramrphPFV.INTR kakàpmINF sɔgɔsɔgɔsɔ̀gɔsɔgɔvtousser kakàpmINF jijíneau ɲɛlafinmanɲɛ́lafinmannɲɛ́noeilláppàfìnmanadjnoirfìnvqnoirmanmrphADJ dɔdɔ́dtmcertain bɔbɔ́vsortir , oòprnce bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF aàpers3SG jirajìravmontrer kokócopQUOT banabànanmaladie inìndtmDEF bɛbɛ́copêtre aàpers3SG fogonfogonfógonfogonnpoumon laláppà .
